facts.text: 30 % on the evaluation phase only; funded accounts not concerned.
facts.excerpt: *Under the Maintain Consistency rule, which applies during the evaluation phase only, no single trading day can account for more than 30% of the total PnL. In practice, this means traders will need at least four profitable trading days to complete an evaluation. If one trading day accounts for more than 30% of the total profit, the trader must continue trading until that day represents 30% or less of the total.
